Class InputAction

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an input action, which can be triggered by various input types and devices. Handles state, multi-tap, hold, and axis sensitivity/gravity.

Properties

AccessTag

The access tag used for locking/unlocking this action. Determines access of this action. Only used when input actions are locked. If this tag is contained in the lock blacklist while the lock is active, the action will not trigger. If this tag is contained in the lock whitelist while the lock is active, the action will trigger. If AllAccessTag is used the action will always trigger. 

public uint AccessTag { get; }

Property Value

uint

AxisGravity

How fast an axis moves towards 0 after no input is detected. Used for calculating InputState.Axis values.

public float AxisGravity { get; set; }

Property Value

float

AxisSensitivity

How fast an axis moves towards the max value (1 / -1) in seconds. Used for calculating InputState.Axis values.

public float AxisSensitivity { get; set; }

Property Value

float

HoldDuration

The duration required to trigger a hold action (in seconds). Default is 1 second.

HasAccess(InputAction)

Determines if the specified action has access.

public static bool HasAccess(InputAction action)

Parameters

action InputAction

The input action to check.

Returns

bool

True if access is granted; otherwise, false.

HasAccess(uint)

Determines if the specified access tag has access. AllAccessTag always returns true (has access). If tag is contained in the current blacklist, this function will return false (no access). If tag is not contained in the current blacklist and tag is contained in the current whitelist, or the current whitelist is empty, this function will return true (has access). 

public static bool HasAccess(uint tag)

Parameters

tag uint

The access tag to check.

Returns

bool

True if access is granted; otherwise, false.

Lock()

Locks the input system, clearing all whitelists and blacklists. Only InputAction with AllAccessTag will be able to trigger. 

public static void Lock()

Lock(BitFlag, BitFlag)

Locks the input system with a specific whitelist and blacklist. All InputAction with a tag contained in the whitelist will be able to trigger. All InputAction with a tag contained in the blacklist will not be able to trigger. 

public static void Lock(BitFlag whitelist, BitFlag blacklist)

Parameters

whitelist BitFlag

The whitelist of access tags.

blacklist BitFlag

The blacklist of access tags.

LockBlacklist(BitFlag)

Locks the input system with a specific blacklist. All InputAction with a tag contained in the blacklist will not be able to trigger. 

public static void LockBlacklist(BitFlag blacklist)

Parameters

blacklist BitFlag

The blacklist of access tags.

LockWhitelist(BitFlag)

Locks the input system with a specific whitelist. All InputAction with a tag contained in the whitelist will be able to trigger.
